name: Altitude Steel Structures
old_description: Design your steel building online in minutes with our free 3D Builder. Customize every detail, compare options, and request a personalized quote—all before making your purchase.
about:
Altitude Steel Structures operates from South Salt Lake City, Utah. The company has been in business for 2.5 years, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly stated. The business began with a focus on providing custom steel buildings through an online 3D design tool that allows customers to configure structures before purchase.

The company designs, engineers, fabricates, and installs custom steel buildings including carports, storage buildings, workshops, and agricultural structures. All services—structural engineering, foundation work, fabrication, delivery, and installation—are performed in-house. To date, Altitude has completed over 200 buildings across Utah, Idaho, and Colorado. The structures use coated galvanized steel and Sherwin Williams paint finishes.

Customers range from general contractors and small business owners to residential homeowners. A general contractor chose Altitude for a storage facility after comparing wood and steel options. A sprinkler business owner needed a 30-by-50-foot shop for equipment storage. Other projects include custom detached garages with windows and vents, a metal building praised by a building inspector, and a garage converted from architect drawings. Installations are typically completed in one to two days.

Altitude differentiates itself with a fully integrated in-house process, 100 percent U.S.-sourced steel components, and warranties covering workmanship for one year, steel components for 20 years, and paint for 20 years. Contractors are fully licensed and meet local and international safety standards. A free online 3D builder lets clients customize every detail and request quotes instantly.
